findings.current: He’d played two cheat cards at once.
findings.defect: “Cheat cards” changes the source’s cheat-key/code image into a playing-card image and weakens the gaming joke.
findings.rationale: The Korean uses 치트키, the familiar gaming term for a cheat key/code. The accepted baseline rendered this as “cheat codes.”
findings.replacement: He’d used two cheat codes at once.

summary: Two minor fidelity issues: an omitted fact about the Skeleton King and a weakened rendering of the cheat-code joke.
